strings.subtitle: — Sachinel Kemtz'ib' —
strings.dnd_unavailable: K'olom ma k'o. Tij le botón pa xe'.
strings.shred_button: S A C H I N
strings.ssd_warning: K'ax! Pa SSD, TRIM rumal, re b'ey re ma nuk'ul ta sachin. Re programa xa HDD.
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS ruk'u'x tzij (ADS) ma xsamaj.
• USN wuj ma xch'aj.
• K'olom wachib'al chuqa' cloud
  (OneDrive, etc.) ma xk'ax.
strings.status_full: Ronojel xch'aw k'o zero. Ma tikirel nitzolij — samajib'äl xa zero nril.
strings.status_fast: Jolom, ruk'isib'al chuqa' 4 MB tz'uk xch'aw. Ruch'akul ma xk'ax, xa rumal k'ax, ma tikirel nitzolij ronojel. Pa juk'ul wuj, taja' TZ'AQAT.
strings.status_empty: Kemtz'ib' q'ax, ma xk'atzin ta nch'aw. Xsach.
strings.error_permission: Ma tikirel nok pa kemtz'ib'. Rik'in jub'a' k'o pa jun chik programa. Titz'apij chuqa' taja' chik.
strings.error_not_found: Ma xilitäj kemtz'ib'. Rik'in jub'a' xsach chik.
strings.error_is_symlink: Re re jun b'ey wachib'al. B'ey ma tikirel nisach — kemtz'ib' xtipa q'ij.
strings.error_reparse: Re re kemtz'ib' pa cloud (OneDrive). Ruk'u'x tzij pa cloud, ma pa disk — ma k'o nisach.
strings.error_not_file: Re re ma jun kemtz'ib' (rukemtz'ib' o jule'). Tik'olom kemtz'ib'.
strings.error_hardlinks: Re kemtz'ib' k'o chik b'ey ch'ak' ({n}). B'ey ch'ak' ma k'o jolom — ronojel b'i' junam. We nisach pa re b'ey, tzij xch'aw chuqa' xq'or 32 byte, xa k'o chik b'ey nok. Tisach ronojel b'ey nab'ey.
strings.error_compressed: Kemtz'ib' xpitz', xwäch o sparse. Zero nch'aw ma nuk'ul ta sachin tzij ojer, NTFS jun chik rub'eyal nuk'u'.
